textRuns.value: Solder Paste Height — Xbar-R Control Chart: investigate out-of-control signals and verify printing process conditions.  PCB Defective Proportion — p-Chart: review abnormal inspection periods and affected PCB lots.  Stencil Cleaning — SOP Compliance Review: verify execution of the stencil cleaning procedure.  Process Capability — Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk: evaluate capability after confirming process stability.  Defect Prioritization — Pareto Analysis: prioritize recurring and high-impact defect categories.

This page uses live model measures to compare yield, defective proportion, DPMO, variation, mean paste height and capability. Results describe synthetic manufacturing data only and do not establish real-world causality. SPC limits are trial limits calculated separately by phase; fewer signals are descriptive within phase and do not prove improved operational stability under a common fixed reference. The source data has no complete stencil-cleaning execution log, so no SOP rate, approval, maintenance, or accountability claim is shown.
Method note: missing alarm evaluations remain blank in the new unique-alert measure; they are not silently converted to zero. A subgroup violating both Xbar and R is counted once.
